<script>
(function(){const a=document.getElementById('audio'),b=document.getElementById('play'),s=document.getElementById('scrub'),t=document.getElementById('elapsed'),d=document.getElementById('duration'),w=document.getElementById('wave');
function fmt(v){if(!Number.isFinite(v))return '—:——';return Math.floor(v/60)+':'+String(Math.floor(v%60)).padStart(2,'0')}
b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(a.paused){const p=a.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch((err)=>{const m=document.getElementById('audioHelp');if(m)m.textContent='This preview blocked direct audio playback. Use the native player or open the MP3.';});}else a.pause()});
a.addEventListener('play',()=>{b.textContent='Ⅱ';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Pause Already Done');w.classList.add('playing')});
a.addEventListener('pause',()=>{b.textContent='▶';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Play Already Done');w.classList.remove('playing')});
a.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',()=>{d.textContent=fmt(a.duration)});a.addEventListener('timeupdate',()=>{t.textContent=fmt(a.currentTime);if(a.duration&&document.activeElement!==s)s.value=Math.round(1000*a.currentTime/a.duration)});
s.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(a.duration)a.currentTime=s.value/1000*a.duration});
})();
</script>
<script>document.getElementById('audioDownload').href=document.getElementById('audio').src;</script>
